probe: C1.3 — PreCompact and the veto, measured on the installed binary
method: manual /compact via `claude --continue -p` in the A166 probe workspace, which still carried its ten-event hook set; veto measured by appending an exit-2 PreCompact hook and counting system/compact_boundary transcript lines before and after
trigger_unmeasured: auto — needs a context-full session; the sensor wiring is identical for both, and nothing is claimed about auto until it is observed

veto.observed: the CLI printed 'Compaction blocked by PreCompact hook: [...] PRECOMPACT-VETO-PROBE' and the compact_boundary count stayed at 1 — compaction did not run
veto.sensor_stance: the sensor never vetoes: its exit-0 absolute stands; the blocking power is measured, recorded, and deliberately unused — ThruLine reads, it never runs

compaction_markers: a completed compaction lands a system/compact_boundary line in the transcript, and SessionStart re-fires with source=compact immediately after — a second insurance signal the sensor already records

bonus_measurement.note: SubagentStop fired during the probe runs and carries agent_transcript_path — the subagent-artifact feed a later C-item will want; recorded, not yet wired
